cydress.ac.description: Wall AC unit with a painted fan grille, drip pipe and bevelled case.

cydress.awning.description: Folded shop awning with scalloped painted valance and two thin braces.

cydress.barrel.description: Hexagonal industrial drum with rolled rims and a recessed top.

cydress.bench.description: Tapered cantilever street bench with a sloped back and painted metal slats.

cydress.bin.description: Octagonal street bin with domed lid and inset waste slot.

cydress.bollard.description: Tapered street bollard with an amber painted cap.

cydress.cart.description: Delivery trolley with tapered cargo case, handles and two low-poly wheels.

cydress.crates.description: Stacked chamfered delivery cases with straps and inset panel faces.

cydress.cup.description: Small tapered reusable drink cup with rolled rim, lid and straw.

cydress.pipe_elbow.description: Bent wall drainpipe with socket collars; original industrial silhouette.

cydress.shutter.description: Recessed roll shutter in a chamfered steel portal.

cydress.speaker.description: Club speaker with splayed case and two painted recessed cones.

cydress.traffic_signal.description: Traffic signal on bent arm; three dim painted lamps, not an emissive flood.

cydress.water_tank.description: Rooftop six-sided water tank with conical rain cap and splayed support legs.

cyroom.apartment.description: Apartment shell: painted panel walls, shadow skirting and recessed coves.

cyroom.bar.description: Chamfered long club bar, overhanging top and inset lit lip.

cyroom.bed.description: Low apartment bed with bevelled frame, painted quilt and pillow.

cyroom.booth.description: Curved segmented padded club booth around a small pedestal table.

cyroom.canopy.description: Station canopy on raked tapered columns, folded roof and recessed light strip.

cyroom.chair.description: Seat for scenes: a swivel office chair, or a heavy bolted captive chair with high back, arm cuffs and a lit status band (a scene prop, no gore).

cyroom.club.description: Low club shell: recessed coves, raised chamfered dance floor, open door sockets.

cyroom.den.description: Hacker den shell with a service plinth, painted panel walls and light coves.

cyroom.desk.description: Workstation with chamfered desktop, tapered supports and original monitor glyph displays.

cyroom.lobby.description: Corporate lobby shell with tapered octagonal columns and tiled relief walls.

cyroom.locker.description: Chamfered station lockers with inset shutter doors and handles.

cyroom.platform.description: Station platform tile: raised bevelled edge with tactile hazard line and lit coping.

cyroom.portal.description: Chamfered transit doorway frame: tapered jambs, bevelled lintel, narrow inset light strips.

cyroom.rooftop.description: Rooftop deck with low relief parapets and a tapered stairhead, open to the skyline.

cyroom.server.description: Server hall shell: dark panel walls; night finish adds a panel floor, lit tile ceiling, cable trays and cyan strip lights.

cyroom.sofa.description: Tapered upholstered sofa with rounded chamfered arms and padded back.

cyroom.subway.description: Subway shell with tiled walls, rail trough, two rails and safe walking platform.

cyroom.train.description: Static chamfered transit carriage with sloped nose and painted windows, no real logos.

cyroom.turnstile.description: Transit turnstile with tapered reader pedestal and three-bar hub.

cysign.adpanel.description: Free-standing backlit ad panel (street furniture): a slim chamfered frame on two feet with the same lit display on both faces and a neon crown line.

cysign.arcade.description: Arcade front 'Hexcade Hall' (invented): a glazed shopfront with a door gap, glowing game cabinets inside, a chase-light frame around the opening and a joystick-pictogram glyph sign.

cysign.banner.description: Cloth banner hung perpendicular to a wall from a bracket pole: a long glyph banner (fabric atlas, slot cloth) with a weighted hem rod, both faces painted.

cysign.billboard.description: Rooftop billboard: a framed display (book atlas ad: ring emblem, glyph line, colour bars) on a braced truss with a catwalk and lamp arms. Reads as a landmark against the skyline.

cysign.blade.description: Projecting blade sign: a tall chamfered box perpendicular to the wall on two brackets, both faces showing a lit glyph column (paper atlas), a cap and an outer neon edge tube. The classic canyon-street sign.

cysign.clinic.description: Clinic front 'Patchwell Clinic' (invented): pale tiled half-walls, sliding glass doors, a reception counter inside, a lit canopy strip and a cross-pictogram glyph sign.

cysign.frame.description: Neon sign frame: a chamfered box carrying a lit glyph panel (screen atlas, slot colour) with a neon top tube; flat on a wall, hung perpendicular off a bracket (two faces) or standing on rooftop legs.

cysign.holo.description: Holographic card prop: a squat projector with a glowing emitter ring, a thin light shaft and a floating double-sided card (screen or book atlas cell) tilted toward the street.

cysign.hotel.description: Hotel entrance 'Hotel Halflight' (invented): a deep marquee canopy with a lit underside, glass double doors to a warm lobby glow, two potted shrubs and a tall vertical glyph blade above.

cysign.noodle.description: Noodle bar front 'Lanternfold Noodles' (invented): a timber counter across the shop slot with stools, noren cloth strips, paper lanterns, a lit menu board on the back wall and a bowl-pictogram glyph sign.

cysign.pawn.description: Pawn shop front 'Twice-Owned' (invented): a half-dropped roll shutter, a barred display window full of pawned goods, a ring-pictogram glyph sign and a small blade.

cysign.roof.description: Rooftop glyph sign: a row of big single-glyph panels (one glyph each, cut from the paper atlas blade column) on a braced lattice frame with a catwalk: the skyline's readable landmark.

cysign.ticker.description: LED ticker strip: a long slim housing with a lit glyph band (screen sign cells repeated) and a neon lip, mounted along a facade fascia or a bridge deck.

cysign.tube.description: Free-form neon tube sign on a dark mounting plate: a ring, arrow, chevron, wave, bolt or heart bent from one glowing tube (light atlas slot row), wall-mounted on stand-offs.

cysky.airship.description: Static advertising airship with a cigar envelope and small gondola; no real brands.

cysky.arch.description: Bevelled-crown skyline card for the megastructure horizon.

cysky.cargo.description: Static cargo lifter with broad hull and underslung twin engine nacelles.

cysky.corner.description: Two perpendicular skyline cards closing a distant city corner.

cysky.courier.description: Static delta courier aircraft: swept lofted hull, small navigation beacon.

cysky.far.description: Far skyline card in haze-role values for a distinct city depth layer.

cysky.halocard.description: Broken projected halo sign made of sparse line cards, no logo or real glyph.

cysky.hololine.description: Single subdued holographic line card linking skyline nodes.

cysky.megatower.description: Distant megatower: octagonal taper and offset observation halo, a skyline anchor.

cysky.near.description: Near skyline card: eight original chamfer-crown silhouettes, painted windows.

cysky.needle.description: Skyline card of varied needle silhouettes, not a single flat rectangle.

cysky.network.description: Sparse original holo network card: six points joined by a broken diagonal rhythm.

cysky.shuttle.description: Static compact city shuttle with a narrow swept hull.

cysky.stepped.description: Stepped residential skyline layer with uneven parapet rhythm.

cystreet.alley.description: Back alley, 1 cell wide: grime ground, one-sided building-back walls (facade texture, painted windows), drain channel, wall pipes and a caged wall lamp; straight, dead end, corner or tee. Open to the sky.

cystreet.bridge.description: Pedestrian footbridge across a street: a slim chamfered deck with glass-panel railings, a neon underside and two stair piers at the ends.

cystreet.corner.description: L corner, 3 x 3 cells: the street turns from south to east; outer sidewalks on the north and west sides.

cystreet.crossing.description: Four-way crossing, 3 x 3 cells: asphalt box with crosswalk bars on every arm, four corner sidewalks with curbs and a manhole decal. The street sockets of every arm meet a cystreet.road end.

cystreet.elevated.description: Elevated road deck, 3 cells wide: an asphalt deck on a thick chamfered girder with lit parapet strips, a tapered central pylon with a hammerhead capital. Chains end to end at deck height.

cystreet.end.description: Street end, 3 x 1 cells: the road stops at a raised paving apron with light-capped bollards and a stop line: where a street meets a plaza or a pedestrian lane.

cystreet.metro.description: Metro entrance: a stairwell cut into the sidewalk descending `depth` metres between tiled walls, a canopy frame with a glyph sign and railings; the lower landing ends in a dark tunnel opening.

cystreet.plaza.description: Plaza tile: wet stone tiles with a paving border, inlaid neon light lines (ring or cross) and an optional central planter seat. Tiles together into squares in front of towers and stations.

cystreet.rail.description: Elevated monorail: a chamfered box-section beam with a lit underside strip on a Y pylon; chains end to end (cyroom.train cars ride on top).

cystreet.ramp.description: Street ramp: a two-cell incline with hazard-striped edges, kerb walls and a lit handrail; for vehicles, carts and level changes between street and plaza.

cystreet.road.description: Straight street segment, 3 cells wide: wet asphalt road (8 m), raised paving sidewalks with chamfered curbs, painted centre dashes or a double line, curb drains. Chains end to end on the street sockets.

cystreet.sidewalk.description: Raised sidewalk tile(s) 0.15 m proud of the road: paving or wet tiles, chamfered curbs on the road sides. Fills building fronts, alley mouths and plaza edges.

cystreet.stairs.description: Street stairs climbing `rise` over two cells: chamfered treads in a stone-faced flight between side walls, railings and neon nosing strips; lands on a raised plaza, walkway or station deck.

cystreet.tee.description: T junction, 3 x 3 cells: arms north, south and east, a continuous sidewalk on the west side; crosswalk bars.

cystreet.walkway.description: Elevated walkway along a facade: a 2 m deck on wall brackets with railing and a lit lip, mounted at a storey line (origin on the wall face). Links fire escapes, stairs and upper shop doors.

cytech.antenna.description: Rooftop antenna cluster: a short mast with dish antennas on yokes, a whip array and a blinking beacon.

cytech.barrier.description: Street barrier: a sloped jersey block with a hazard band and reflector, a light-strip rail barrier on feet, or a row of light-capped bollards.

cytech.bike.description: Neon motorbike (parked): two disc wheels with glowing rims, a lofted fairing, a leather seat, a headlight and tail strip; racer = low, long fairing.

cytech.cables.description: Overhead cable run spanning a street or alley: a bundle of sagging catenary cables between two wall brackets, optionally strung with small lit lanterns. Origin at mid-span, bracket height (placed at the anchor height).

cytech.camera.description: Security camera on a wall bracket: a chamfered housing with a lens ring and a red-eye status lamp (wall mounted, origin on the wall face).

cytech.charger.description: Charging post for hover cars and bikes: a slim chamfered pedestal with a lit display, a coiled cable holster and a neon ring at the base.

cytech.conduit.description: Power conduit run along a wall: parallel insulated pipes on stand-off clamps, junction boxes with a hazard band and a status light (wall-mounted, origin on the wall face).

cytech.drone.description: Quad drone (static dressing, placed hovering): a lathed hull pod, four arms with rotor rings, a glowing belly lamp; a parcel box (courier), a light bar (patrol) or a camera ball (camera).

cytech.hovercar.description: Hover car (static prop): a lofted wedge hull, a glass canopy, four glowing hover pods instead of wheels, an underglow strip and tail lights; taxi (roof glyph sign, hazard stripe), van (tall box) or patrol (light bar).

cytech.puddle.description: Rain puddles: irregular flat water decals (water role: dark sheen with slow ripples) a few millimetres above the street, so wet asphalt catches the neon. Several blobs per piece.

cytech.rack.description: Server rack row: vented dark cabinets with rows of status lights (light atlas row strips) and a cable bundle looping out of the top into the ceiling tray.

cytech.street_light.description: Street light: a tapered pole on a chamfered plinth, a curved arm (two for double) and a long lamp head with a lit underside (light atlas slot); the emitter sits under the head.

cytech.terminal.description: Street terminal: a tapered pedestal kiosk with an angled lit screen (book monitor cell), a wall-hung info panel, or an ATM block with keypad and card slot.

cytech.utility.description: Utility cabinet or transformer box: a vented painted housing with hazard band, conduit stubs into the ground, a small status light and a glyph warning plate.

cytech.vending.description: Vending machine: a chamfered painted body with a lit product panel (book atlas menu cell), a dark dispensing slot, a neon header strip and side stripe; the capsule kind wears a glass dome of toy capsules.

cytech.vent.description: Rooftop machinery: an AC condenser with a fan grille, a mushroom exhaust stack, a big turbine fan housing or an elbow duct with a hazard band. Roof clutter that makes a skyline read as lived-in.

cytower.annex.description: Low corner building: a 1-4 storey chamfered block with a corner sign mast, rooftop AC boxes and water tank, lit window bands; fills street corners and rooftop views between towers.

cytower.arch.description: Megastructure arch over a street: two tapered chamfered legs, a deep span block with lit window bands, a neon underside and an optional hanging blade sign. A landmark gateway between canyon blocks.

cytower.balcony.description: Wall-mounted balcony unit: a bevelled slab on brackets, rail panel, and an AC box, laundry line or planter; a small neon edge on the slab lip. Mounts on any facade storey (origin on the wall face).

cytower.crown.description: Rooftop crown: a neon halo ring on raked struts (single, double ring, or a fan of radiating light spokes) over a chamfered plinth. Tops any tower roof socket.

cytower.drum.description: Round drum tower with a gentle bulge, vertical fins, lit window bands around the drum and a saucer disc, dome or helipad crown edged with a neon ring.

cytower.facade.description: Street facade (canyon wall): a one-sided storey frontage on a cell edge facing the street, ground-floor shop slots (open recess or roll shutter) that take the shopfront kits, painted windows with lit bands, balcony slabs, end pilasters and a cornice, neon or stepped roofline.

cytower.garden.description: Rooftop garden module: chamfered planter beds with lawn and soil, small trees and clipped hedges, a pergola frame, a bench and low garden lamps. The only living green of the city, kept tidy (no clutter).

cytower.needle.description: Tapered octagonal needle tower on a stepped podium: trim band rings, lit window bands that follow the taper, a glowing crown halo and a needle spire.

cytower.setback.description: Stepped setback slab tower: chamfered tiers stepping back toward the top, neon ledge strips on every setback, painted storeys with lit window bands, a machine room and an antenna mast or crown halo.

cytower.skybridge.description: Enclosed skybridge spanning a street between two towers: a chamfered glazed tube with end flanges, lit window band and a neon underside strip. Origin at the deck centre; placed at height between facades.

cytower.spire.description: Rooftop antenna spire: a tapered four-leg lattice mast with cross braces, dish antennas and a beacon tip.

cytower.stack.description: Dense residential stack: offset chamfered blocks cantilevered over each other, AC boxes and balcony slabs on the faces, a rooftop water tank and antenna clutter, warm lit windows.

cytower.twin.description: Twin slender chamfered towers on a shared podium, joined by a glazed skybridge with a neon underside, stepped caps and lit window bands.

cytower.wedge.description: Wedge tower: a chamfered slab cut by a steep sloped roof, a full-height neon edge tube on the front corner, a rooftop billboard frame on the slope and lit window bands.

sky.backdrop.description: Sky backdrop: inward-facing dome or cylinder (kit_shell_sky, role 'sky', v = elevation 0..1). Origin at the viewer; extends below y=0 by below_horizon*radius.

note: Every GLB here exists for consumers only with this sha256 (explicit sRGB8 after validation; source_sha256 = validated build). textures are relative to kits/library/.
